hints.title: Peak Detection and Expansion
hints.text: Identify local peaks strictly greater than both neighbors, then expand down the slopes in both directions.

hints.title: Left and Right Incline Sweeps
hints.text: Whenever arr[i - 1] < arr[i] > arr[i + 1], expand left while strictly increasing and right while strictly decreasing.

hints.title: Skip to Valley Base
hints.text: After evaluating a peak, advance the main pointer directly to the right foot of the mountain to guarantee linear scan efficiency.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Single pass peak identification and linear slope expansion in O(1) space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking overlapping intervals repeatedly causes quadratic time behavior.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Jump i to right foot of current mountain to achieve strict O(N) single-pass runtime.
